blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Fishing families in Zambales who are struggling with dwindling catches and restricted access to Bajo de Masinloc deserve an explanation of the P319 million in China-linked remittances received by CALE88 Foods Corp., a company associated with Vice President Sara Duterte’s husband, lawyer Manases Carpio, Zambales Rep. Doris Maniquiz said. Maniquiz raised the issue as she described the impact of the difficulties faced by fishermen at Bajo de Masinloc on their livelihoods and families. Some fishermen who once earned P5,000 a week now make only P200 to P300, she said. “It’s really saddening. We are struggling here, and then […]...
